fields.Name: T213 - Developer Tools Class Registry Group Expand and Priority Detail
fields.Description: Exercises the accordion expand/collapse plus the ClassFactory priority winner/shadowed visualization (IsWinningRow/IsConflictRow), distinct from the search-filter path.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'Class Registry'. Click a base-class group header to expand it (or use the 'Expand' button in the header to expand all groups). Success is the accordion group EXPANDING to reveal its registrations table with Key, Subclass, and Priority columns; where a base class has multiple registrations for the same key, look for a 'winner' (crown) or 'shadowed' badge indicating which registration wins by priority. Then click the header again (or 'Collapse') to verify the group collapses. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Expanding a group reveals a registrations table with Key / Subclass / Priority columns
The group can be collapsed again, and Expand/Collapse controls affect the group visibility (override winner/shadowed badges may appear where applicable)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
